notes.title: 0429 Update
notes.content:
1. Added resolution options
2. Modified two levels of shooting stealth, no need to shoot from a long distance, just put the basketball in the hoop
3. The final shooting level only needs to put the ball in the basket.
4. Removed some noise effects of night vision goggles
5. After entering the work, the second stealth level of the blank level is deleted, and you only need to sneak once
6. Fixed the issue that the screen turned black when you returned to the main menu and continued to play the game after entering the studio for the second time after entering the street.
7. The task prompt file at the self-study room level will delete misleading information about the green candle
8. Replace the female ghost in the study with the red female ghost.
9. Slightly increase the level of brightness in the study room
10. When the code lock rotates, slightly increase the repeating time by 0.2 seconds to avoid the error of repeating zooming
11. The CD time of the lighter is reduced to a random number of 1-3 seconds
